name: Administrative portal for client invoices
dialogues: On my company, we had a sales system that was used by several clients
Repeteadly, we needed to check information of the clients from the database, complicating its easy operation
Developed a portal for internal use that allowed to easily manage client information and check their usage of the system
This system made easier the work of the company and the decision making
Developed REST APIs with services that used Java Spring Boot sequences, improving the maintainability of the system
Integrated error checking to the forms, verifying the integrity of the data to be registered
Used tables and graphs with multiple filters to facilitate different requests

images.caption: Example of a request for information about a client and its operations
Simple interface with the functionalities in the top menu
Requests through a table with filters, without the need of SQL
Generation of graphs with filters that query the database
